firm_data.firm_description: Entwistle & Cappucci LLP is a law firm representing public and private institutional investors in complex securities and commercial litigations. The firm also handles corporate finance and transactional matters, internal investigations, and general corporate matters.
notable_facts: Recovered $126.3 million for investors in In re Alta Mesa Resources, Inc. Securities Litigation.
Recovered more than $1.1B for clients in In re Royal Ahold N.V. Securities and ERISA Litigation.
Successfully worked with the SIPA Trustee and regulators to negotiate the 100 percent recovery by customers of all net equity losses in the MF Global litigation.

additional_contacts.name: Vincent R. Cappucci
additional_contacts.title: Senior Partner, Chair of Securities Litigation Department

email.subject: AI for Entwistle & Cappucci, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

Your $126.3 million recovery in In re Alta Mesa Resources shows what precision litigation work looks like. That level of investor advocacy requires the kind of focused, efficient case management that stretched teams struggle to maintain at scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what smaller practices actually need: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Austin to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how we're helping securities and commercial litigation teams compete with larger firms.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
